text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
I feel kinda sorry for the inspector gettin' hung out to dry like that.
An' jus' where the heck did that Hanzo character disappear to...?
Not that I should be sympathizin' though, huh?
choice_data_list: From the dark he came; into the dark he went.
Maybe he's closer than we think...
text_block_list.orig_text:
見捨てられた監査官、
少し憐れだったべ。
それにしても
ハンゾウって人は
どこに消えたんだべ……
同情する必要なんかねぇはずなんだけどな。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
That's sure how it seems. I guess it's some special kinda magic.
It must be a mighty formidable technique if Nightmare can't even
find him. Crazy how we managed to win against that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな感じだったな。
なんかの魔法だったんだべか。
王宮騎士団も見つけられてねぇんだから、
相当のやり手だったんだべな。
いや～、
オラたちそんなのによく勝てたな。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Jus' deserts, huh? Fate willing, he'll be made to pay for his crimes.
I sure hope nobody else is made to suffer by his hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
因果応報、
だべな。
きちんと罪を償ってほしいべや。
これ以上つらい目にあう人は
出てほしくねぇべ。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
D-don't say such scary things! But he is the kind to show up
unexpectedly, so I wouldn't be surprised if he jus' popped outta the
shadows.If he does, I'll turn him into shish kebab with this here bident.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなこえぇこと言うもんでねぇ！
けんど、
本当に神出鬼没だったから、
いきなり現れても
不思議でねぇな。
出てきたら
がんばって捕まえてやるべさ！
